name: v004_jsm_schema_state
ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jsm_schema_state (installation_id VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY, schema_version INT NOT NULL, ready INT NOT NULL, checkpoints VARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v004_jsm_configuration
ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jsm_configuration (installation_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL, configuration_json VARCHAR(4096) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (installation_id, tenant_id)) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v004_jsm_intents
ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jsm_intents (installation_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, incident_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, marker VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, configuration_json VARCHAR(4096) NOT NULL, request_json VARCHAR(8192) NOT NULL, state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL, attempts INT NOT NULL, reconciliations INT NOT NULL, due_at VARCHAR(24) NULL, lease_token VARCHAR(36) NULL, lease_until VARCHAR(24) NULL, issue_id VARCHAR(20) NULL, issue_key VARCHAR(64) NULL, reason VARCHAR(24) NULL, audit_json VARCHAR(4096) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (installation_id, tenant_id, id), UNIQUE KEY uq_jsm_incident (installation_id, tenant_id, incident_id), UNIQUE KEY uq_jsm_issue (installation_id, issue_id), UNIQUE KEY uq_jsm_marker (installation_id, marker), INDEX ix_jsm_due (installation_id, tenant_id, state, due_at)) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin
